Author: OOFGames
Name: Mini Games Emporium
Punchline: Four live gambling games under one roof, with more on the way.
Description: The all-in-one hosting tool for FFXIV gambling venues, with four live games: BAR 777, Deathroll Tournament, Higher/Lower, and Raffle. Handles player queues, trade verification, boosted pots, ticket draws, automated chat, and a full transaction ledger.
Changelog:
- Added the Raffle game: numbered tickets, boosted pot, per-player limit, closing timer and a /random winner draw.
- Bug fixed on total pot showing incorrectly when adding/removing from it.
- Added new chat setting option to Deathroll Tournament to have a custom tell message when waiting for a player to roll.
